name: Tags Image
description: An observer saw this tag on that image: the tag's registry, repository and name pointed at the image host with that digest. It does not say the tag points there now. A tag that has moved keeps an edge to each image it was seen on, and detected_at says when the observer saw it. A reference, not containment: an image outlives every name it has had.

detected_at.description: When the observer says it saw the tag on this image, as an RFC 3339 date-time. Absent where the observer gives no time. Of two edges from one tag, the later detected_at is the more recent sighting; it is still not a claim about now.
